findings.namedBuyers: Two commercially relevant verified organizer routes: Claire Damary, Chargée de projets Salon du livre, is the named exhibitor/project contact (claire.damary@palexpo.ch; +41 22 761 10 72); Natacha Bayard, Directrice du salon, is the event-leadership escalation route via info@salondulivre.ch / +41 22 761 11 11. Nine Simon is the verified artistic director and a secondary programme-related introduction route. None is publicly identified as the hotel contracting signatory or named housing manager. Do not equate these roles with proven procurement control.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: 24–28 February 2027, 41st edition. The June 2026 official exhibition regulations, Article 2, state: “L’exposition aura lieu à PALEXPO du mercredi 24 au dimanche 28 février 2027.” These are activity dates, not publication dates. The organizer homepage and venue calendar corroborate them. Within the requested horizon. No official 2028 dates found; tentative third-party February 2028 listings are not announcements.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using the supplied hotel specification: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a 237-room Founex hotel, not a downtown Geneva host. Only an independently bookable publisher/exhibitor/staff subgroup could justify a conditional satellite-lodging or small ancillary-meeting pitch; no such open subgroup is yet evidenced. Use the supplied roughly 20–120-room guidance as a sales sizing constraint, NOT an estimate of event demand. Six meeting rooms/up to about 250 theatre do not make it a replacement for the Palexpo fair. Resort/retreat characteristics are not a demonstrated requirement. The 12-place fellowship is below that target scale and explicitly requires a hotel near Cornavin, so it is a poor current-edition fit. Do not assume banquet capacity, free transport eligibility, hotel shuttle service, airport-arriving delegates, or whole-house demand.
findings.venueCommitments: Palexpo, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Territory: Geneva Airport corridor, not Founex/Nyon/La Côte and not downtown Geneva. The 2027 exhibition location is explicitly committed in the official regulations. Palexpo is an exhibition venue, not a competing hotel. No specific 2027 hall identified in the cited event listing. Separately, fellowship lodging is organizer-reserved at an unnamed hotel described as five minutes on foot from Genève-Cornavin station; this is a city-centre lodging commitment, not an identified hotel contract.
findings.historicalRotation: Repeated Palexpo editions: 22–26 March 2023; 6–10 March 2024; 19–23 March 2025; 18–22 March 2026; then 24–28 February 2027 confirmed. These records show recurring use of the same venue, not a rotating destination opportunity. A decentralized Geneva-city format existed in 2022 before the documented 2023 return to Palexpo. No evidence of a forthcoming move to La Côte or a hotel venue.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Edition-specific evidence exists for the 24–26 February 2027 fellowship only: 12 places, organized with LivreSuisse, with “Deux nuits d’hôtel, soit mercredi soir et jeudi soir (réservées par le fellowship).” The hotel is unnamed and “à 5 minutes à pied de la gare principale Genève-Cornavin”; the programme includes hotel-to-Palexpo transfers and reimbursed second-class rail travel. This proves organizer-arranged accommodation for that subprogramme, not public hotel inventory. No official edition-specific hotel list, named host hotel, published room block, open accommodation RFP, or general exhibitor housing mandate was found. Consequently there are no officially listed edition-specific hotel names to report. Palexpo Hotel Reservation advertises “De la définition des besoins à la pré-réservation d’un contingent de chambres” and an online booking tool, but this generic service is NOT proof it handles Salon 2027. Public service contact: info@palexpohotelreservation.ch, +41 22 761 10 11. Broader lodging sourcing remains unconfirmed.
findings.organizationStructure: The legal organizer is PALEXPO SA: Article 1 states the salon “est organisé par PALEXPO SA”, a société anonyme owning/managing/operating the exhibition and congress venue. This is a corporate-organized public literary fair with professional programming, not an association congress or a corporate/private celebration. Salon du livre de Genève is the event brand; Palexpo is both venue and legal organizer. LivreSuisse collaborates on the fellowship; it is not thereby established as the general fair organizer. No external PCO/DMC role established for this edition. Palexpo Hotel Reservation is a possible accommodation-service pathway, not a verified edition-appointed bureau.
findings.competitiveLimitations: A specific competitive limitation is evidenced: fellowship lodging is reserved centrally by the programme near Cornavin for two nights. The hotel name, room quantity, rates and contract terms are undisclosed; do not describe a named incumbent or an open block. Generic hotel promotional pages and third-party hotel suggestions do not establish Salon 2027 commitments. No sourced sold-out condition, accommodation shortage, overflow request, displaced group, or confirmed YOTEL allocation was found. The event’s on-site catering is also restricted by Article 17.3 to Palexpo Restaurants and approved partners; it is not an open hotel catering opportunity.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Claire Damary first, copying the salon general inbox and requesting referral to Natacha Bayard or the actual accommodation lead. Ask whether non-fellowship publisher/exhibitor/production teams book independently, whether Palexpo Hotel Reservation manages any 2027 allocation, which hotels are committed, and whether any named subgroup would accept Founex with costed transfers. Contact info@palexpohotelreservation.ch separately to establish mandate and supplier-onboarding requirements, not to assume an RFP exists. Offer only a conditional small subgroup lodging/meeting proposal after the buyer, nights, room count and transfer budget are confirmed. Do not quote for the whole fair or target the already arranged Cornavin fellowship as open inventory.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Event dates and exhibition venue are confirmed; hotel sales accessibility is not. Fellowship accommodation is already organizer-arranged and centrally located. For other participants, neither independent booking freedom nor a comprehensive housing-bureau mandate has been verified. Therefore retain as conditional relationship development, not qualified open room demand. The 2027 exhibitor registration deadline of 2 December 2026 is a useful outreach timing signal, not a hotel-procurement deadline.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: recurring Palexpo editions justify cultivating the organizer and relevant publishers for future independently sourced subgroups, but do not imply an open future hotel tender or venue rotation. A future fellowship bid would require an explicit change to its documented Cornavin-centred logistics; it is not presently a good displacement target for Founex. No official 2028 dates or hotel tender identified. Keep future-cycle capture separate from the confirmed 2027 event.
